events.title: The Boozy Book Fair – Castle Rock Edition
events.description: Early holiday shopping starts here. Give the gift of stories. Kick off your holiday shopping at The Boozy Book Fair™—where every purchase helps put books into the hands of local kids. Join us at Sinners & Saints, in partnership with Sudden Fiction Books, for a grown-up book fair featuring curated books, bookish gifts, craft cocktails, and plenty of N/A options. Shop with impact while finding meaningful gifts for every reader on your list (or yourself!). 🎟 Tickets • $10 includes one drink 💛 Shop With Impact Sinners & Saints is donating 10% of sales, and Sudden Fiction is donating 10% of book and gift sales to Burning Through Pages. Burning Through Pages is a Denver-based youth literacy nonprofit empowering young minds through peer-led book clubs, Teacher Support Grants, and community library builds.
events.location: Sinners & Saints — 221 Perry Street, Castle Rock, CO, 80104
